devices.modulation_format: 2PAM at 256 GBd; 4PAM at 170 GBd; 8PAM at 96 GBd
devices.notes: Row granularity: one row per distinct device (MZM, IQ, racetrack); DC and RF Vpi and all data-rate points share the row. Vpi columns are per phase shifter (3.6 V DC, 6.4 V at 40 GHz); the push-pull MZ Vpi of 1.8 V at DC (paper headline) is in vpi_mzm_pushpull_dc_v. 6.4 V at 40 GHz is given in phase-shifter context, MZ-level RF Vpi not stated. 3 dB BW is referenced to 10 GHz (response drops several dB between 10 MHz and 10 GHz) and sits at the 110 GHz measurement limit; Fig. 2d normalization not stated. No on-chip IL reported: 20.3 dB is fiber-to-fiber incl. 2.8 dB per grating coupler and 3.5 dB per photonic-to-plasmonic converter (cutback); paper simulates ideal 8.1 dB fiber-to-fiber (not entered). prop_loss is the plasmonic section only (0.5 dB/um); BTO waveguide 4.5 dB/cm not entered. Fiber transmission over 400 m: 256 GBd 2PAM BER 3.11e-2, 4PAM 160 GBd BER 4.00e-2. Linear-EQ-only (21-tap FFE) reaches 196 GBd. Pockels coefficient about 180 pm/V at 40 GHz (paper extraction). Bias for Vpi not given as a value: BTO fully poled before the DC sweep; 2-3 V poling bias used in data runs. Not reported: Z0, n_RF, ng, RF loss, electrode thickness, ER, net rate.
